name: How do I choose a reliable contractor for foggy window glass replacement in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose a reliable contractor for foggy window glass replacement in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor for foggy window glass replacement, prioritize those with strong local experience and positive customer reviews, especially within the Bay Area. Look for companies that are licensed, bonded, and insured, like City Dweller, LLC. Obtain multiple detailed quotes to compare costs and services. Ensure they offer a warranty on both materials and labor. Ask about their process, from measurement to installation, and clarify what types of glass options they provide to ensure quality and compatibility with your home's needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a reliable contractor with local experience, good reviews, proper licensing, and clear warranties on materials and labor.
